description: This Java class implements the GroupService interface, providing methods to list user groups by type or IDs. It uses Spring Framework annotations for dependency injection and extends a generic service implementation.

classes.name: GroupServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of GroupService providing methods to retrieve user groups based on type or IDs, extending generic service functionality.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects matching the specified GroupType, wrapping exceptions into ServiceException.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects matching the specified set of IDs, handling exceptions accordingly.

methods.name: GroupServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor injecting GroupDao dependency and passing it to the superclass.
